_comment: Transcribed from an in-game screenshot taken 2026-08-01 (Steam capture index 92 in the 16:03 run). Gadget screens carry a name, a model designation and a description but no stat block or trait chips, so this item has no stats or ratings. Art is cropped from the same shot. The page leads with the model designation because that is what EA's patch notes use.
name: M320A1 HE

description.text: Fires impact-triggered grenades designed for damaging structures and targeting infantry behind cover. Can be carried standalone or underslung on weapons with a Gadget Mount attachment for faster access.
